title: Multimodal Clinical Integration Transformer for Automated Veterinary Radiology Report Generation

contributions.purpose: 多模态融合生成兽医放射报告
contributions.mechanism: MCIT:CNN 视觉特征 + 结构化临床病史融合的 Transformer 编解码架构
contributions.domain: 兽医放射报告自动生成
contributions.source_quote: 1) Multimodal Data Fusion, which integrates radiographic images with structured clinical data for more context-aware reports

contributions.purpose: 把预测临床发现注入报告生成
contributions.mechanism: Clinical Finding Integration:将预测的临床发现直接并入多模态上下文以锚定异常
contributions.evaluation: Clinical F1 0.920、Node Accuracy 0.950;消融去该模块 F1 降到 0.782
contributions.source_quote: It integrates predicted clinical findings directly into the multimodal context, allowing the model to ground report generation in specific abnormalities.

contributions.mechanism: 在 5000 犬胸片数据集上对比基线并做消融
contributions.evaluation: 消融:去临床数据 F1 0.920→0.828,去发现整合 →0.782(声称超所有基线)
contributions.source_quote: The effectiveness of our approach, as demonstrated on a dataset of 5,000 canine chest X-rays

notes: 严重数据红旗(疑造数):正文明写"Baseline metrics are simulated for illustrative purposes",Table 1 全部 10 个基线数字为编造;且基线行与自身消融行数字雷同——HRGR-Agent(0.434/0.527/0.298/0.723/0.782/0.808)= 消融 w/o Clin.Find.Int. 行,Knowledge-Driven GBRG(0.459/0.558/0.315/0.765/0.828/0.855)= 消融 w/o Clin.Data 行;基线各列近似等差递增(BLEU-4 0.179→0.230→0.281...)。定性报告示例亦"simulated ... for data privacy"。数据集"5000 犬胸片"proprietary 不可共享(不可验证),data flow 含"synthetic patient"上下文。分数异常高(报告生成 BLEU-4 0.510)。checklist AI 自披露:实验设计与代码 AI 主导([B]/[C],"AI agent wrote and executed all the code")。type=method 但实证声明不可信。
